<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="IT-Anforderungscheckliste - BayernLB">e64c1801d4ec0750b0e430d0df3c400b</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:495c5c01d4ec0750b0e430d0df3c4021</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>SubmitDateValidation</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue === '') {
        return;
    }

    // Get the current date without time
    var currentDate = new Date();
	currentDate.setHours(0,0,0,0);

    // Get the value of ita_desired_submission_date
    var newDate = newValue.split('.');
    var submissionDate = new Date(newDate[2] + '-' +newDate[1] + '-' + newDate[0]);
    // Check if submissionDate is in the past
    if (submissionDate < currentDate) {
        g_form.clearValue('u_quote_due_date');
        g_form.showFieldMsg('u_quote_due_date', 'Der Termin liegt in der Vergangenheit.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    // Get the value of ita_desired_deployment_date
    var deploymentDate = g_form.getValue('u_latest_delivery_date');
    if (deploymentDate) {
		deploymentDate = deploymentDate.split(".");
		deploymentDateParsed = new Date(deploymentDate[2] + '-' +deploymentDate[1] + '-' + deploymentDate[0]);

        // Compare submissionDate and deploymentDate
        if (submissionDate > deploymentDateParsed) {
            g_form.clearValue('u_quote_due_date');
            g_form.showFieldMsg('u_quote_due_date', 'Der Bereitstellungstermin darf nicht vor dem Termin für die Vorlage des Angebots liegen.', 'error');
        }
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-27 14:21:29</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>fa5cdc01d4ec0750b0e430d0df3c40a9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SubmitDateValidation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_fa5cdc01d4ec0750b0e430d0df3c40a9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-12 13:28:10</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188387b2a0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>catalog_script_client_fa5cdc01d4ec0750b0e430d0df3c40a9</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>cd369968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc084a1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:45</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="IT-Anforderungscheckliste - FI-TS">e918ec0984c50710b96b6020db8226b2</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:bb28a84984c50710b96b6020db822697</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Latest Delivery Date Validation</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    // Get the current date without time
    var currentDate = new Date();
    currentDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    // Get the value of ita_desired_deployment_date
    var newDate = newValue.split('.');
    var deploymentDate = new Date(newDate[2] + '-' + newDate[1] + '-' + newDate[0]);
    // Check if deploymentDate is in the past
    if (deploymentDate < currentDate) {
        g_form.clearValue('u_latest_delivery_date');
        g_form.showFieldMsg('u_latest_delivery_date', 'Der Termin liegt in der Vergangenheit.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    // Get the value of ita_desired_submission_date
    var submissionDate = g_form.getValue('u_quote_due_date');
    if (submissionDate) {
        submissionDate = submissionDate.split(".");
        submissionDateParsed = new Date(submissionDate[2] + '-' + submissionDate[1] + '-' + submissionDate[0]);

        // Compare submissionDate and deploymentDate
        if (deploymentDate < submissionDateParsed) {
            g_form.clearValue('u_latest_delivery_date');
            g_form.showFieldMsg('u_latest_delivery_date', 'Der Bereitstellungstermin darf nicht vor dem Termin für die Vorlage des Angebots liegen.', 'error');
        }
    }

}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-22 11:44:43</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>ca38ac4984c50710b96b6020db82269b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Latest Delivery Date Validation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_ca38ac4984c50710b96b6020db82269b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-22 11:44:43</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883874560000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>catalog_script_client_ca38ac4984c50710b96b6020db82269b</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>74365968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0849b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:43</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

    if (isLoading || !newValue) {
        g_form.setValue('u_tech_email', '');
		g_form.setValue('telefon', '');
		g_form.setValue('abteilung', '');
        return;
    }

    g_form.getReference('u_technical_contact_name', function(contact) {
        if (contact) {
            g_form.setValue('u_tech_email', contact.email);
			g_form.setValue('telefon', contact.phone);
			g_form.setValue('abteilung', contact.department);
        }
    });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-01 12:13:58</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>37ce4c1c84198f10b96b6020db822605</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Technical Contact fields</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_37ce4c1c84198f10b96b6020db822605</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-21 08:46:44</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188386b370000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>catalog_script_client_37ce4c1c84198f10b96b6020db822605</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>0c361968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0846f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:41</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_rel_widget_clone"><sp_rel_widget_clone action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><child display_value="Copy of Data Table from URL Definition">22a137519ce28b10b0e4a23b78988365</child><cloned>2026-08-06 10:37:31</cloned><last_validated>2026-08-06 10:37:31</last_validated><parent display_value="Data Table from URL Definition">8ae61f55cb21020000f8d856634c9c93</parent><payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><sp_widget><category>standard</category><client_script><![CDATA[function($scope, $rootScope, $location, spUtil, $timeout, spAriaFocusManager) {
	var canNavigate = true;
	if ($scope.data.dataTableWidget)
		angular.extend($scope.data.dataTableWidget.options, $scope.options);

	$scope.$on('data_table.click', callDataClick);

	$scope.$on('select2.ready', function(e, $el){
		if ($scope.data.invalid_table){
			e.stopPropagation();
			$el.select2('open');
		}
	})

	$scope.selectedTable = {
		displayValue: $scope.data.table,
		value: $scope.data.table
	}

	function resetParams(){
		delete $scope.data.p;
		delete $scope.data.o;
		delete $scope.data.d;
		delete $scope.data.q;
		delete $scope.data.table;
	}

	$scope.onChange = function() {
		resetParams();
		$scope.data.table = $scope.selectedTable.value;
		$scope.data.fields = "";  // reset
		$scope.data.invalid_table = false;
		getData(true);
	}
	
	function callDataClick(e, parms) {											
			var oid = $location.search().id;
			var p = $scope.data.page_id || 'form';
			var s = {id: p, table: parms.table, sys_id: parms.sys_id, view: $scope.data.view};
			if (oid == p) {
				s.spa = 1;
				var t = $location.search();
				s = angular.extend(t, s);
				$rootScope.$broadcast('$sp.list.click', s);
			}

			var newURL = $location.search(s);
			spAriaFocusManager.navigateToLink(newURL.url());										
	}

	function getData(updateUrl) {
		var f = $scope.data;
		spUtil.update($scope).then(function(data) {
				$scope.data.dataTableWidget = null;
				$timeout(function(){
					$scope.data.dataTableWidget = data.dataTableWidget;
					angular.extend($scope.data.dataTableWidget.options, $scope.options);
					if (updateUrl)
						setPermalink(f.table);
				});
		});
	}

	function setPermalink(table) {
		$scope.ignoreLocationChange = true;
		var searchParms = $location.search();
		var search = {
			spa: 1,
			table: table,
			id: searchParms.id
		};
		$location.search(search);
	}
}]]></client_script><controller_as/><css>.widget-data-table .clearfix {
  display: none;
}

.panel-primary .panel-heading {
  button:not(.btn-default) {
    &amp;:focus {
      outline-color: #FFFFFF;
      border-color: #FFFFFF;
      box-shadow: 0px 0px 5px #FFFFFF;
    }
  }
}
</css><data_table>sp_instance_table</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list>title,glyph,color,sp_page</field_list><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>data-table-from-url</id><internal>false</internal><link/><name>Data Table from URL Definition</name><option_schema>[{"hint":"Show Instance option title instead of the table's plural label","name":"use_instance_title","default_value":"false","section":"Presentation","label":"Use Instance Title","type":"boolean"},{"hint":"If enabled, show the filter in the breadcrumb section of the table","name":"enable_filter","default_value":"false","section":"Presentation","label":"Enable Filter","type":"boolean"}]</option_schema><public>false</public><roles>snc_external,snc_internal</roles><script><![CDATA[(function() {
	deleteOptions(['table','field_list','filter','order_by', 'order_direction','order','maximum_entries']);
	if (input) {
		data.table = input.table;
		data.view = input.view;
	} else {
		data.table = $sp.getParameter('table') || $sp.getParameter('t');
		data.view = $sp.getParameter('view');
	}

	if (!data.table) {
		data.invalid_table = true;
		data.table_label = "";
		return;
	}

	var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(data.table);
	if (!gr.isValid()) {
		data.invalid_table = true;
		data.table_label = data.table;
		return;
	}

	// page is where the record URLs go, URL parameter wins
	data.page_id = $sp.getParameter("target_page_id");
	if (!data.page_id) {
		var sp_page = $sp.getValue('sp_page');
		if (sp_page) {
			var pageGR = new GlideRecord('sp_page');
			pageGR.get(sp_page);
			data.page_id = pageGR.id.getDisplayValue();
		}
	}

	// widget parameters
	data.table_label = gr.getLabel();
	data.fields = $sp.getListColumns(data.table, data.view);
	copyParameters(data, ['p', 'o', 'd', 'filter','fixed_query']);
	copyParameters(data, ['relationship_id', 'apply_to', 'apply_to_sys_id']);
	data.filterACLs = true;
	data.show_new = true;
	data.show_keywords  = true;
	data.show_breadcrumbs = true;
	data.fromUrl = true;
	data.useInstanceTitle = (options.use_instance_title == "true");
	data.headerTitle = data.useInstanceTitle ? options.title : gr.getPlural();
	data.enable_filter = input.enable_filter || options.enable_filter == true || options.enable_filter == "true";
	data.dataTableWidget = $sp.getWidget('widget-data-table', data);
	

	function copyParameters(to, names) {
		names.forEach(function(name) {
			data[name] = $sp.getParameter(name);
		})
	}

	// in case this widget is tied to the wrong instance type
	function deleteOptions(names) {
		names.forEach(function(name) {
			delete options[name];
		})
	}
})()]]></script><servicenow>true</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2015-07-28 19:54:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>8ae61f55cb21020000f8d856634c9c93</sys_id><sys_mod_count>419</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Data Table from URL Definition</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Service Portal - Core" source="com.glide.service-portal">ec5f5400ffa203001f182ebbc75b5eb8</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_8ae61f55cb21020000f8d856634c9c93</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEZF23</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2023-07-07 08:58:16</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div>
  <div ng-if="data.invalid_table">
    <div class="alert alert-info">
      <span ng-if="data.table_label">${Table not defined} '{{data.table_label}}'</span>
      <span ng-if="!data.table_label">${Select table on field below or specify on URL} ?id=list&amp;table=table_name</span>
    </div>
    <sn-record-picker field="selectedTable" table="'sys_db_object'"
                      display-field="'label'"
                      value-field="'name'"
                      display-fields="'name'"
                      search-fields="'label,name'" page-size="100" on-change="onChange()" ></sn-record-picker>
  </div>
  <div ng-if="data.dataTableWidget && !data.invalid_table">
  	<sp-widget widget="data.dataTableWidget"></sp-widget>
  </div>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget></payload><sys_class_name>sp_rel_widget_clone</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE64</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-06 10:37:31</sys_created_on><sys_id>eaa177519ce28b10b0e4a23b78988373</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>22a137519ce28b10b0e4a23b78988365</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_rel_widget_clone_eaa177519ce28b10b0e4a23b78988373</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE64</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-06 10:37:31</sys_updated_on></sp_rel_widget_clone><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188386b770000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sp_rel_widget_clone_eaa177519ce28b10b0e4a23b78988373</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>88361968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc08477</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:41</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sn_doc_template_script"><sn_doc_template_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>SOM_Quote_Script_Cover_Date</name><script><![CDATA[(function runTemplateScript(target, docTemplate) {
    var gdt = new GlideDateTime(target.quote_date);
    var dateStr = gdt.getLocalDate().toString(); // Format: yyyy-MM-dd
    var parts = dateStr.split('-');  // [yyyy, MM, dd]
    
    // Umformatieren zu dd.MM.yyyy
    if (parts.length === 3) {
        return parts[2] + '.' + parts[1] + '.' + parts[0];
    }
    
    return dateStr; // Fallback, wenn Format nicht stimmt
})(target, docTemplate);]]></script><sys_class_name>sn_doc_template_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-30 07:20:29</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>4d61282990b147104699312928162f38</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SOM_Quote_Script_Cover_Date</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sn_doc_template_script_4d61282990b147104699312928162f38</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-30 07:32:34</sys_updated_on></sn_doc_template_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a18838800b0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sn_doc_template_script_4d61282990b147104699312928162f38</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>2d36d968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0844a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:46</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

ADD HEADER ROWS (Rows 2-7) // Row 2: Referenz var referenzText = quote.getValue('u_request_id') + '\n' + 'ITAB IT-Systemnummer: ' + (quote.getValue('u_lbbw_solution_itab_number') || '0 - kein ITAB-Bezug') + '\n' + 'Ansprechpartner: ' + quote.getDisplayValue('u_lbbw_request_responsible') + '\n' + 'Angebotener Leistungszeitraum: ' + quote.getValue('u_lbbw_solution_start_date') + ' - ' + quote.getValue('u_lbbw_solution_end_date'); excelPayload.push({ TYPE: 'INFO', NAME: 'Referenz', DESCRIPTION: referenzText, DELIVERY_TIME: '', QUANTITY: '', ORDER_UNIT: '', CURRENCY: '', TAX: '', PRICE_QUANTITY: '', PRICE_AMOUNT: '', PAYROLL_CATEGORY: '', SUPPLIER_PID: '', BUYER_PID: '', BUYER_MATERIAL_GROUP: '', REMARK: '' }); // Row 3: Leistungsumfang var leistungsumfangText = 'Dieser Einzelvertrag unterliegt grundsätzlich den Regelungen des Rahmenvertrages über die Erbringung von IT-Leistungen in der Fassung, die zum Zeitpunkt des Abschlusses dieses Einzelvertrages gültig ist.\n\nAufbau einer dedizierten Monitoring-Instanz:'; excelPayload.push({ TYPE: 'INFO', NAME: 'Leistungsumfang', DESCRIPTION: leistungsumfangText, DELIVERY_TIME: '', QUANTITY: '', ORDER_UNIT: '', CURRENCY: '', TAX: '', PRICE_QUANTITY: '', PRICE_AMOUNT: '', PAYROLL_CATEGORY: '', SUPPLIER_PID: '', BUYER_PID: '', BUYER_MATERIAL_GROUP: '', REMARK: '' }); // Row 4: Non Standard Beschreibung excelPayload.push({ TYPE: 'INFO', NAME: 'Non Standard Beschreibung', DESCRIPTION: quote.getValue('u_non_standard_beschreibung') || '', // Adjust field name DELIVERY_TIME: '', QUANTITY: '', ORDER_UNIT: '', CURRENCY: '', TAX: '', PRICE_QUANTITY: '', PRICE_AMOUNT: '', PAYROLL_CATEGORY: '', SUPPLIER_PID: '', BUYER_PID: '', BUYER_MATERIAL_GROUP: '', REMARK: '' }); // Row 5: Abgrenzung des Leistungsumfangs excelPayload.push({ TYPE: 'INFO', NAME: 'Abgrenzung des Leistungsumfangs', DESCRIPTION: quote.getValue('u_lbbw_solution_leistungszuordnung') || '', // Adjust field name DELIVERY_TIME: '', QUANTITY: '', ORDER_UNIT: '', CURRENCY: '', TAX: '', PRICE_QUANTITY: '', PRICE_AMOUNT: '', PAYROLL_CATEGORY: '', SUPPLIER_PID: '', BUYER_PID: '', BUYER_MATERIAL_GROUP: '', REMARK: '' }); // Row 6: Beistellungspflichten des Auftraggebers excelPayload.push({ TYPE: 'INFO', NAME: 'Beistellungspflichten des Auftraggebers', DESCRIPTION: 'TBD', // Adjust field name DELIVERY_TIME: '', QUANTITY: '', ORDER_UNIT: '', CURRENCY: '', TAX: '', PRICE_QUANTITY: '', PRICE_AMOUNT: '', PAYROLL_CATEGORY: '', SUPPLIER_PID: '', BUYER_PID: '', BUYER_MATERIAL_GROUP: '', REMARK: '' }); // 2. PROCESS QUOTE LINE ITEMS (Row 8+) // Assuming your quote line item table is sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item var qli = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item'); qli.addQuery('quote', quote.getUniqueValue()); qli.query(); while (qli.next()) { var leistungsartNr = qli.getValue('u_lbbw_leistungsnummer'); // Adjust field name if different var menge = parseFloat(qli.getValue('quantity') || 0); // Adjust 'quantity' field name if different // Determine Aufbau vs Abbau var actionType = (menge >= 0) ? 'Aufbau' : 'Abbau'; // Query the MDE Directory var mdeGr = new GlideRecord('u_lbbw_mde'); mdeGr.addQuery('u_leistungsart_nummer', leistungsartNr); mdeGr.addQuery('u_name', 'CONTAINS', actionType); mdeGr.query(); if (mdeGr.next()) { // Formatting DELIVERY_TIME based on year boundary rules var startVal = quote.getValue('u_erfuellungszeitraum_von'); var fulfillmentStart = startVal ? new GlideDateTime(startVal) : new GlideDateTime(); var endVal = quote.getValue('u_erfuellungszeitraum_bis'); var fulfillmentEnd = endVal ? new GlideDateTime(endVal) : new GlideDateTime(); var qliYear = qli.getValue('u_jahr'); var deliveryTimeStr = ''; if (fulfillmentStart.getYearLocalTime() == qliYear && fulfillmentEnd.getYearLocalTime() == qliYear) { deliveryTimeStr = fulfillmentStart.getDate().getByFormat('dd.MM.yyyy') + ' - ' + fulfillmentEnd.getDate().getByFormat('dd.MM.yyyy'); } else if (fulfillmentStart.getYearLocalTime() == qliYear) { deliveryTimeStr = fulfillmentStart.getDate().getByFormat('dd.MM.yyyy') + ' - 31.12.' + qliYear; } else if (fulfillmentEnd.getYearLocalTime() == qliYear) { deliveryTimeStr = '01.01.' + qliYear + ' - ' + fulfillmentEnd.getDate().getByFormat('dd.MM.yyyy'); } // Push mapped MDE data + Overrides into the payload excelPayload.push({ TYPE: mdeGr.getValue('u_type'), NAME: mdeGr.getValue('u_name'), DESCRIPTION: mdeGr.getValue('u_description'), DELIVERY_TIME: deliveryTimeStr, QUANTITY: Math.abs(menge), REMARK: "LB_Nr " + qli.getValue('u_erloesvertragsnummer') }); } else { // Requirement: Meaningful error message if no matching position is found errorMessage = 'Fehler: Keine passende MDE-Position für Leistungsart-Nummer ' + leistungsartNr + ' (' + actionType + ') gefunden.'; break; // Stop processing } } if (errorMessage) { outputs.error_msg = errorMessage; return; } // 3. FILE GENERATION (CSV Placeholder // Define the column headers expected by LBBW var headers = [ 'TYPE', 'NAME', 'DESCRIPTION', 'DELIVERY_TIME', 'QUANTITY', 'REMARK', 'PRICE', 'TAX' // Add all other necessary columns here ]; // Build the CSV string (using semicolon for German Excel compatibility) var csvContent = headers.join(';') + '\n'; for (var i = 0; i < excelPayload.length; i++) { var row = excelPayload[i]; var rowArray = []; for (var h = 0; h < headers.length; h++) { var cellValue = row[headers[h]] || ''; // Escape quotes and wrap in quotes if the value contains a semicolon or newline cellValue = cellValue.toString().replace(/"/g, '""'); if (cellValue.indexOf(';') > -1 || cellValue.indexOf('\n') > -1) { cellValue = '"' + cellValue + '"'; } rowArray.push(cellValue); } csvContent += rowArray.join(';') + '\n'; } // Construct the filename var fileName = 'AG ' + quote.getValue('u_lbbw_quote_evn') + ' ' + quote.getValue('u_lbbw_offer_id') + ' ' + new GlideDateTime().getDate().getByFormat('YYYY-MM-dd') + '.xlsx'; // Use GlideSysAttachment to attach the file to the Quote record var gsa = new GlideSysAttachment(); var attachmentSysId = gsa.write(quote, fileName, 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet', csvContent); // Update the specific MDE field on the Quote to store this attachment reference quote.setValue('u_angebots_excel_fuer_mde', attachmentSysId); quote.update(); // Pass the attachment sys_id out of the action just in case the subflow needs it outputs.attach_id = attachmentSysId; } catch (e) { outputs.error_msg = 'Skriptfehler bei der Excel-Generierung: ' + e.message; } })(inputs, outputs);71aa7f6647032200b4fad7527c9a719bsys_hub_step_instancecf48ae7a286fc7101f185d5cd001e075400sys_variable_valueIZEAE352026-09-29 14:10:40974822ba286fc7101f185d5cd001e0890IZEAE352026-09-29 14:10:4035aa573fd7802200bdbaee5b5e610375f5e56d79b3101300176b051a16a8dce4applicationcf48ae7a286fc7101f185d5cd001e075IZEAE352026-09-29 14:10:40134822ba286fc7101f185d5cd001e0880IZEAE352026-09-29 14:10:40var__m_sys_flow_step_definition_input_106afb6647032200b4fad7527c9a71e7

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item">u_position_numberVALCHANGES^quoteISNOTEMPTY^u_position_numberISNOTEMPTY^NQquoteVALCHANGES^quoteISNOTEMPTY^u_position_numberISNOTEMPTY^EQ<item endquery="false" field="u_position_number" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="quote" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="ISNOTEMPTY" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="u_position_number" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="ISNOTEMPTY" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="quote" goto="false" newquery="true" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="quote" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="ISNOTEMPTY" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="u_position_number" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="ISNOTEMPTY" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Resolve Duplicate Position Number</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /* null when async */) {
var parentQuote = current.getValue('quote');
    var requestedPosition = current.getValue('u_position_number');
    var currentSysId = current.getUniqueValue();
// Defensive check: ensure required attributes exist
    if (!parentQuote || !requestedPosition) {
        return;
    }
// 1. Check if another line item on the same Quote uses this position
    var dupCheck = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item');
    dupCheck.addQuery('quote', parentQuote);
    dupCheck.addQuery('u_position_number', requestedPosition);
    dupCheck.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', currentSysId); // Exclude self
    dupCheck.setLimit(1);
    dupCheck.query();
// No duplicate found -> proceed with update normally
    if (!dupCheck.next()) {
        return;
    }
// 2. Duplicate found -> find highest position number among OTHER line items
    var maxCheck = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item');
    maxCheck.addQuery('quote', parentQuote);
    maxCheck.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', currentSysId); // Exclude self
    maxCheck.addNotNullQuery('u_position_number');
    maxCheck.orderByDesc('u_position_number');
    maxCheck.setLimit(1);
    maxCheck.query();
var nextPosition = 1;
if (maxCheck.next()) {
        var highestPositionNumber = parseInt(maxCheck.getValue('u_position_number'), 10) || 0;
        nextPosition = highestPositionNumber + 1;
    }
// 3. Assign the newly calculated position directly to current
    current.setValue('u_position_number', nextPosition);
// 4. Retrieve translated message and display to user session
    var msg = gs.getMessage(
        'Position number is already used. Position number was set to {0} instead.',
        [nextPosition]
    );
gs.addInfoMessage(msg);
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAD65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-08 11:27:29</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>b7081cb5c8b34310b96bb192bcbe79c9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Resolve Duplicate Position Number</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_b7081cb5c8b34310b96bb192bcbe79c9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAD65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-08 11:27:29</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=b7081cb5c8b34310b96bb192bcbe79c9"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188387a390000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_b7081cb5c8b34310b96bb192bcbe79c9</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>89369968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0847e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:45</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

	var splitLineLink = new QuoteLineAPI().checkIfLineIsSource(current);

		current.setAbortAction(true);
		gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage("Original lines are locked after splitting to preserve pricing and term accuracy based on the effective date. Please update the split line {0}",splitLineLink ));
	}

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>maint</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-09-24 22:23:27</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>e87c3233340cb210f87735ac999006dc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Abort change when a source line</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_e87c3233340cb210f87735ac999006dc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEZG57</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-26 13:15:16</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=e87c3233340cb210f87735ac999006dc"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a18838749f0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_e87c3233340cb210f87735ac999006dc</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>b4365968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc084a4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:43</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt_core.ExcelExportService</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Generates LBBW-compliant Excel export file from Quote records using a temporary staging table (sn_quote_mgmt_core_export_staging). The script maps parent Quote data to static INFO headers (rows 2-7) and their according Quote fields, then iterates through associated Quote Line Items. For each item, it dot-walks to the Product Offering to retrieve the Service Type Number (Leistungsart), queries the custom u_lbbw_mde table for attributes, calculates cross-year delivery timelines, and inserts all records into the staging table before exporting and attaching the final Excel file to the Quote.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ExcelExportService</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ExcelExportService = Class.create();
ExcelExportService.prototype = {

    STAGING_TABLE: 'sn_quote_mgmt_core_export_staging',
    QUOTE_TABLE: 'sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote',
    QLI_TABLE: 'sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item', 
	AUTH_PROFILE_PROPERTY: 'sn_quote_mgmt_core.excel_export.auth_profile_id',

    initialize: function (sourceGr) {
        this.source = sourceGr;
        this.runId  = gs.generateGUID();
        this.order  = 0;
    },

    run: function () {
        try {
            this._buildRows();
            return this._generateAndAttach();
        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error('ExcelExportService failed: ' + ex.message);
            return { ok: false, error: ex.message };
        } finally {
            this._cleanup();
        }
    },

    _addRow: function (type, name, description, delivery, qty, unit, currency, tax, priceQty, priceAmt, payroll, suppPid, buyPid, buyMatGrp, remark) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.STAGING_TABLE);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setValue('u_run_id',        this.runId);
        gr.setValue('u_order',         ++this.order);
        
        gr.setValue('u_type',          type);
        gr.setValue('u_name',          name);
        gr.setValue('u_description',   description);
        gr.setValue('u_delivery_time', delivery);
        gr.setValue('u_quantity',      qty);
        gr.setValue('u_order_unit',    unit);
        gr.setValue('u_currency',      currency);
        gr.setValue('u_tax',           tax);
		gr.setValue('u_price_quantity', priceQty);
        gr.setValue('u_price_amount',  priceAmt);
        gr.setValue('u_payroll_category', payroll);
        gr.setValue('u_supplier_pid',  suppPid);
        gr.setValue('u_buyer_pid',     buyPid);
        gr.setValue('u_buyer_material_group', buyMatGrp);
        gr.setValue('u_remark',        remark);
        
        gr.insert();
    },

	_buildRows: function () {
        // ==========================================
        // 1. INFO ROWS (Zeilen 2 - 7)
        // ==========================================
        var offerId = this.source.getValue('u_lbbw_offer_id') || '';
        var itab = this.source.getValue('u_lbbw_solution_itab_number') || '';
        var assignedTo = this.source.getDisplayValue('assigned_to') || '';
        var validFrom = this.source.getValue('u_document_quote_fulfillment_period_from') || '';
        var validTo = this.source.getValue('u_document_quote_fulfillment_period_to') || '';  
        var dateRange = validFrom + ' - ' + validTo;

        var refDesc = offerId + '\n' + itab + '\n' + assignedTo + '\n' + dateRange;
        this._addRow('INFO', 'Referenz', refDesc, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '');

        var scopeText = 'Dieser Einzelvertrag unterliegt grundsätzlich den Regelungen des Rahmenvertrages über die Erbringung von IT-Leistungen in der Fassung, die zum Zeitpunkt des Abschlusses dieses Einzelvertrages gültig ist.\n\n' + (this.source.getValue('u_document_quote_scope_of_services') || '');
        this._addRow('INFO', 'Leistungsumfang', scopeText, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '');

		var nonStd = (this.source.getValue('u_non_standard_beschreibung') || '').replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '');
        this._addRow('INFO', 'Non Standard Beschreibung', nonStd, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '');

        var delimitation = (this.source.getValue('u_document_quote_delineation_of_the_scope_of_services') || '').replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '');
        this._addRow('INFO', 'Abgrenzung des Leistungsumfangs', delimitation, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '');

        var obligations = (this.source.getValue('u_document_quote_provision_obligations') || '') + '\n\nKündigung und Außerbetriebnahme: Wird durch die Kündigung ein von FI (FI-TS) für die LBBW betreutes System außer Betrieb genommen, schließen die Vertragspartner eine Vereinbarung über den weiteren Umgang mit den bei FI (FI-TS) verbleibenden Daten der LBBW. Die LBBW wird die Anforderungen an die Datensicherung sowie an die Archivierungsfristen an FI (FI-TS) vorgeben. Die der FI (FI-TS) nachweislich entstehenden Kosten der Datensicherung sowie der Archivierung werden gesondert vereinbart, insofern sie nicht bereits durch die laufende Vergütung abgegolten sind.';
        this._addRow('INFO', 'Beistellungspflichten des Auftraggebers', obligations, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '');

        var paymentTerms = this.source.getValue('payment_terms') || 'Die einmaligen Aufwände des Auftragnehmers werden auf Basis der tatsächlichen Aufwände abgerechnet. Die Mehrmengen werden in Stück bestellt. Der Preis pro Stück ergibt sich aus den jeweils gültigen Preisen des vereinbarten Preismodells gemäß Ziff. 3 des IT-RV Anlage 8 (Kommerzielle Regelungen) i.V.m. dem aktuell gültigen Anhang 8-C. Die in diesem Angebot angegebenen Beträge sind netto und erhöhen sich um den zum Zeitpunkt der Rechnungserstellung gültigen Mehrwertsteuersatz.\nEs gelten die im Rahmenvertrag vereinbarten Zahlungsbedingungen.';
        this._addRow('INFO', 'Zahlungsbedingungen', paymentTerms, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '');

        // ==========================================
        // 2. ITEM ROWS (Zeile 8+)
        // ==========================================
        var li = new GlideRecord(this.QLI_TABLE);
        li.addQuery('quote', this.source.getUniqueValue());
        li.query();

		while (li.next()) {
		// 1. QLI Values & Positive Quantity Logic
		var rawQty = parseFloat(li.getValue('quantity') || 0);
		var aufbauAbbau = (rawQty >= 0) ? 'Aufbau' : 'Abbau';
		var finalQty = Math.abs(rawQty).toString();
		var priceAmount = li.getValue('unit_price') || '';
		var remark = 'LB_Nr ' + (li.getDisplayValue('u_erloesvertragsnummer') || '');

		// 2. Delivery Time Logic
		var qliYear = li.getValue('u_som_year') || '';
		var deliveryTime = dateRange; // Defaults to the standard range

		if (qliYear && validFrom && validTo) {
			var startYear = validFrom.substring(0, 4);
			var endYear = validTo.substring(0, 4);

			if (startYear !== endYear) {
				if (qliYear === startYear) {
					deliveryTime = validFrom + ' - 31.12.' + qliYear;
				} else if (qliYear === endYear) {
					deliveryTime = '01.01.' + qliYear + ' - ' + validTo;
				} else {
					deliveryTime = '01.01.' + qliYear + ' - 31.12.' + qliYear;
				}
			}
		}

		// 3. Product Offering Values
		var leistungsart = li.product_offering.u_som_performance_class || ''; 

		// 4. MDE Query & Row Construction
		var mde = new GlideRecord('u_lbbw_mde');
		mde.addQuery('u_leistungsart_nummer', leistungsart); 
		mde.addQuery('u_name', 'CONTAINS', aufbauAbbau);
		mde.query();
		if (mde.next()) {
			// Strip HTML from description
			var rawDescription = mde.getValue('u_description') || '';
			var cleanDescription = rawDescription.replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '');
            cleanDescription = cleanDescription.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ');

			// Format the Tax value dynamically (handles '19', '0.19', and '0,19')
            var rawTax = (mde.getValue('u_tax') || '').toString().trim();
            var formattedTax = rawTax;
            
            if (rawTax !== '') {
                // Swap comma for a period so JavaScript can parse it correctly
                var parseableTax = rawTax.replace(',', '.');
                var taxNum = parseFloat(parseableTax);
                
                if (!isNaN(taxNum)) {
                    // Apply math for whole numbers
                    if (taxNum >= 1) {
                        taxNum = taxNum / 100;
                    }
                    
                    // Force a strict 2-decimal string (e.g., "0.19") to avoid float quirks
                    var exactString = taxNum.toFixed(2);
                    
                    // Split and join to aggressively force the comma replacement
                    var commaString = exactString.split('.').join(',');
                    
                    if (taxNum === 0) {
                        commaString = '0';
                    }
                    
                    
                    formattedTax = commaString;
                }
            }

			// Push the 15 columns exactly in order
			this._addRow(
				mde.getValue('u_type') || '',                 // A: TYPE 
				mde.getValue('u_name') || '',                 // B: NAME 
				cleanDescription,                             // C: DESCRIPTION
				deliveryTime,                                 // D: DELIVERY_TIME
				finalQty,                                     // E: QUANTITY 
				mde.getValue('u_order_unit') || '',           // F: ORDER_UNIT
				mde.getValue('u_currency') || '',             // G: CURRENCY
				formattedTax,                                 // H: TAX
				li.getValue('quantity') || '',                // I: PRICE_QUANTITY 
				li.getValue('unit_price') || '',              // J: PRICE_AMOUNT 
				mde.getValue('u_payroll_category') || '',     // K: PAYROLL_CATEGORY
				mde.getValue('u_supplier_pid') || '',         // L: SUPPLIER_PID
				mde.getValue('u_buyer_pid') || '',            // M: BUYER_PID
				mde.getValue('u_buyer_material_group') || '', // N: BUYER_MATERIAL_GROUP
				remark                                        // O: REMARK 
			);

		} else {
                // Throw error if MDE record is not found
                throw new Error('Fehler: Keine passende Position im MDE-Verzeichnis gefunden für Leistungsart: ' + leistungsart + ' (' + aufbauAbbau + ').');
		}
	}

},


    _findAttachment: function (fileName) {
        var att = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
        att.addQuery('table_name', this.QUOTE_TABLE);
        att.addQuery('table_sys_id', this.source.getUniqueValue());
        att.addQuery('file_name', fileName);
        att.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        att.setLimit(1);
        att.query();
        return att.next() ? att : null;
    },

    _generateAndAttach: function () {
		var gDate = new GlideDate().getValue();
		var evn = this.source.getValue('u_lbbw_quote_evn') || 'EVN';
		var offerId = this.source.getValue('u_lbbw_offer_id') || 'OfferID';
		var fileName = 'AG ' + evn + ' ' + offerId + ' ' + gDate + '.xlsx';

        var profileId = gs.getProperty(this.AUTH_PROFILE_PROPERTY);
        if (!profileId) {
            throw new Error('Excel export: auth profile property is not set');
        }

        var before = this._findAttachment(fileName);
        var beforeId = before ? before.getUniqueValue() : '';

        var query = 'u_run_id=' + this.runId + '^ORDERBYu_order';
        var url = gs.getProperty('glide.servlet.uri') + this.STAGING_TABLE +
            '_list.do?XLSX&sysparm_query=' + encodeURIComponent(query);

        var rm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        rm.setEndpoint(url);
        rm.setHttpMethod('GET');
        rm.setHttpTimeout(30000);
        rm.setAuthenticationProfile('basic', profileId);
        rm.saveResponseBodyAsAttachment(
            this.QUOTE_TABLE,
            this.source.getUniqueValue(),
            fileName
        );

        var res = rm.execute();
        var status = res.getStatusCode();
        var type = String(res.getHeader('Content-Type') || '');

        var att = this._findAttachment(fileName);
        var isNew = att && att.getUniqueValue() != beforeId;

        if (status != 200 || type.indexOf('spreadsheetml') === -1) {
            if (isNew) {
                try {
                    att.deleteRecord();
                } catch (e) {
                    gs.error('Excel export: could not remove bad attachment ' + att.getUniqueValue());
                }
            }
            throw new Error('Excel export failed. HTTP ' + status + ', Content-Type: ' + type);
        }
        if (!isNew) {
            throw new Error('Excel export: attachment was not created');
        }

        // Bind the file to the File Attachment field by storing the attachment's sys_id
        var quote = new GlideRecord(this.QUOTE_TABLE);
        if (!quote.get(this.source.getUniqueValue())) {
            throw new Error('Excel export: quote not found for field update');
        }
        quote.setValue('u_angebots_excel_fuer_mde', att.getUniqueValue());
        quote.update();

        return { ok: true, fileName: fileName };
    },

    _cleanup: function () {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.STAGING_TABLE);
        gr.addQuery('u_run_id', this.runId);
        gr.deleteMultiple();
    },

    type: 'ExcelExportService'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE35</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-08 09:38:19</sys_created_on><sys_id>3d7bb365ddbb43101f18cee3f37d7ae5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>39</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ExcelExportService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_3d7bb365ddbb43101f18cee3f37d7ae5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE35</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-24 10:15:29</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188387a270000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_include_3d7bb365ddbb43101f18cee3f37d7ae5</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>01369968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0847c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:45</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item</collection><condition/><description>LBBW - Sync PdE/PdV ID on manual selection</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item">u_lbbw_pdeVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="u_lbbw_pde" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>LBBW - Sync PdE ID on manual selection</name><order>200</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    if (!current.u_lbbw_pde) {
        current.u_lbbw_pde_pdv_id = '';
		current.u_som_pde_name = '';
        return;
    }

    var pdeRecord = new GlideRecord('u_pde');
    if (pdeRecord.get(current.getValue('u_lbbw_pde'))) {
        current.u_lbbw_pde_pdv_id = pdeRecord.getValue('u_id');
		current.u_som_pde_name = pdeRecord.getValue('u_pde_name');
    } else {
        gs.error('LBBW PDE sync: referenced u_pde record not found for QLI ' + current.getValue('number'));
    }

})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE47</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-02 09:37:04</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>3ba441f77c670f101f180c59224b11d8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LBBW - Sync PdE ID on manual selection</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_3ba441f77c670f101f180c59224b11d8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE47</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-02 11:59:07</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=3ba441f77c670f101f180c59224b11d8"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883854210000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_3ba441f77c670f101f180c59224b11d8</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>72265568f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc08442</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:35</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

        var defaultPL = new sn_quote_mgmt_core.QuotePricingUtil().getDefaultPriceListForQuoteLine(current);
        if (current.price_list != defaultPL) {
            gs.addErrorMessage(QuoteMessage.PRICING_ERROR_MESSAGES.NOT_AUTHORIZED_TO_CHANGE_PRICE_LIST);
            current.setAbortAction(true);
        }
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2023-12-28 03:21:24</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>7b51afb6931b35102a65716684891887</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Allow Price List Selection </sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_7b51afb6931b35102a65716684891887</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEZG57</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-26 12:18:08</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=7b51afb6931b35102a65716684891887"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883858a00000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_7b51afb6931b35102a65716684891887</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>c7265568f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc084e2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:36</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote</collection><condition/><description>Automatically creates a "Presales Consultant" entry in the Quote Internal Contacts table when a Quote is first assigned to a user. To preserve historical tracking, the script verifies if a "Presales Consultant" role already exists for the current quote and only inserts a new record if none is found. This ensures that subsequent reassignments do not automatically overwrite the initial Presales Consultant.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote">assigned_toVALCHANGES^assigned_toISNOTEMPTY^EQ<item endquery="false" field="assigned_to" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="assigned_to" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="ISNOTEMPTY" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Set Initial PreSales Consultant</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    // 1. Query the Internal Contacts table for this Quote to see if a Presales Consultant already exists
    var contactGr = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_internal_contact');
    contactGr.addQuery('u_quote', current.sys_id); // Links to the current Quote record
    contactGr.addQuery('u_rolle', 'Presales Consultant'); // Uses the custom German column name 'u_rolle'
    contactGr.setLimit(1); 
    contactGr.query();

    // 2. If no matching record is found, create the initial entry
    if (!contactGr.hasNext()) {
        var newContact = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_internal_contact');
        newContact.initialize();
        newContact.u_quote = current.sys_id;
        newContact.u_user = current.assigned_to; // Assigns the newly assigned user
        newContact.u_rolle = 'Presales Consultant'; 
        newContact.insert();
    }

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_a588c2cdc1f30b10b96bbab8b674a0ce
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt_core.PDEClientUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>PDEClientUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var PDEClientUtils = Class.create();
PDEClientUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
 
    getPricingMethod: function() {
        var offeringId = this.getParameter('sysparm_offering');
        if (!offeringId) {
            return '';
        }
        var off = new GlideRecord('sn_prd_pm_product_offering');
        if (!off.get(offeringId)) {
            gs.warn('PDEClientUtils: Product Offering not found: ' + offeringId);
            return '';
        }
        return off.getValue('pricing_method') || '';
    },
 
    getLineContext: function() {
        var result = { pricing_method: '', lbbw: false };
 
        var offeringId = this.getParameter('sysparm_offering');
        if (offeringId) {
            var off = new GlideRecord('sn_prd_pm_product_offering');
            if (off.get(offeringId)) {
                result.pricing_method = off.getValue('pricing_method') || '';
            } else {
                gs.warn('PDEClientUtils: Product Offering not found: ' + offeringId);
            }
        }
 
        var accountId = this.getParameter('sysparm_account');
        if (accountId) {
            var acct = new GlideRecord('customer_account');
            if (acct.get(accountId)) {
                // INTERIM (STRY0025450): name match pending Markus confirmation on
                // LBBW identification and subsidiaries. Prefer Customer number or an
                // account flag once confirmed.
                result.lbbw = (acct.getValue('name').indexOf('Landesbank Baden') === 0);
            } else {
                gs.warn('PDEClientUtils: Account not found: ' + accountId);
            }
        }
 
        return JSON.stringify(result);
    },
 
    type: 'PDEClientUtils'
});
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE47</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-06 12:04:27</sys_created_on><sys_id>a588c2cdc1f30b10b96bbab8b674a0ce</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PDEClientUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_a588c2cdc1f30b10b96bbab8b674a0ce</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE47</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-06 15:28:48</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883867a30000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_include_a588c2cdc1f30b10b96bbab8b674a0ce</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>7f26d568f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc084e7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:40</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

    if (isLoading || !newValue) {
        g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_email', '');
		g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_phone', '');
		g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_department', '');
        return;
    }

    g_form.getReference('u_commercial_contact', function(contact) {
        if (contact) {
            g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_email', contact.email);
			g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_phone', contact.phone);
			g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_department', contact.department);
        }
    });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-22 11:44:43</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>8e38ac4984c50710b96b6020db82268b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Commercial Contact fields</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_8e38ac4984c50710b96b6020db82268b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-21 08:46:49</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188386e500000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>catalog_script_client_8e38ac4984c50710b96b6020db82268b</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>d4361968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc084d4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:42</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

    if (isLoading || !newValue) {
        g_form.setValue('u_technical_contact_email', '');
		g_form.setValue('u_technical_contact_phone', '');
		g_form.setValue('u_technical_contact_department', '');
        return;
    }

    g_form.getReference('u_business_contact', function(contact) {
        if (contact) {
            g_form.setValue('u_technical_contact_email', contact.email);
			g_form.setValue('u_technical_contact_phone', contact.phone);
			g_form.setValue('u_technical_contact_department', contact.department);
        }
    });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-22 11:44:43</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>f938ac4984c50710b96b6020db822679</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Business Contact fields</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_f938ac4984c50710b96b6020db822679</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-21 08:46:54</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188387db80000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>catalog_script_client_f938ac4984c50710b96b6020db822679</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>99369968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc084fe</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:46</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

    var periodFrom = target.getValue('u_document_quote_fulfillment_period_from');
    var periodTo = target.getValue('u_document_quote_fulfillment_period_to');
    if (gs.nil(periodFrom) || gs.nil(periodTo)) {

    var periodFromDisplay = target.getDisplayValue('u_document_quote_fulfillment_period_from');
    var periodToDisplay = target.getDisplayValue('u_document_quote_fulfillment_period_to');
    return ' Die Realisierung erfolgt voraussichtlich im Zeitraum von ' + periodFromDisplay + ' bis ' + periodToDisplay + '.';
})(target, docTemplate);]]></script><sys_class_name>sn_doc_template_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE48</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-21 11:12:30</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>3452345cc9a30314b96b412c13023d22</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SOM_Termine_Realization_Sentence</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sn_doc_template_script_3452345cc9a30314b96b412c13023d22</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE48</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-21 11:12:30</sys_updated_on></sn_doc_template_script><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188384e230000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sn_doc_template_script_3452345cc9a30314b96b412c13023d22</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:33</sys_created_on><sys_id>16261568f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0845c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:33</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

Für die sichere Anbindung des internen Bitbucket-Repositories an die CxOne-SaaS-Anwendung muss ein interner DMZ-Server in der BPPROD bzw. PROD.DMZ aufgebaut werden, der als Proxy für die sichere Kommunikation nach außen dient (CxLink). Aufbau DMZ-Server (für CxLink-Service zur sicheren Kommunikation CheckmarxOne (SaaS) -> interne Bitbucket-Repositories). Hierfür wird ein Server (SBK3) in der BPPROD DMZ mit folgenden Leistungsparametern benötigt: * CPU{*}:{*} 4 vCPU * Memory{*}:{*} 16GB RAM * RedHat Linux 9 FCE * Podman-Service zur Verwaltung virtueller Maschinen Zusätzlich für das Staging folgende Server * BPZERT: 2 vCPU, 6GB RAM, Redhat Linux, Podman * HZAE : 2 vCPU, 6GB RAM, Redhat Linux, Podman   2.) Für die föderierte Anmeldung am SaaS-Service mit internen Credentials: |861243 / ADFS Party Trust Proxy| ]]></description><anforderungsmanager><email>Julian.Hermle@LBBW.de</email> <display-name>Hermle, Julian</display-name> <oe></oe> </anforderungsmanager> <fb-verantwortlicher><email>Florian.Winkelmeier@lbbw.de</email> <display-name>Winkelmeier, Florian</display-name> <oe></oe> </fb-verantwortlicher> <it-verantwortlicher><email>Florian.Winkelmeier@lbbw.de</email> <display-name>Winkelmeier, Florian</display-name> <oe></oe> </it-verantwortlicher> <budget-verantwortlicher><email>Julian.Hermle@LBBW.de</email> <display-name>Hermle, Julian</display-name> <oe></oe> </budget-verantwortlicher> <sap-number></sap-number> <kleinauftrag></kleinauftrag> <platform>IT</platform> <delivery-date>2025-11-21 00:00:00.0</delivery-date> <delivery-date-info><![CDATA[ Der Service/Server wird so früh wie möglich benötigt. ]]></delivery-date-info> <ergänzung-anforderung></ergänzung-anforderung> <business-labels></business-labels> <attachments> </attachments> <solution id="DEMAND-18772"> <title>Server/Services für CxOne-SaaS-Anbindung</title> <description><![CDATA[ Der Service der Applikation "Application Security Tools (AST, ITAB 8326) muss im Zuge der Migration in die Cloud um folgende Services/Server erweitert werden:   1.) CxOne-SaaS-Anbindung </title> <description><![CDATA[ Der Service der Applikation "Application Security Tools (AST, ITAB 8326) muss im Zuge der Migration in die Cloud um folgende Services/Server erweitert werden:   1.) Für die sichere Anbindung des internen Bitbucket-Repositories an die CxOne-SaaS-Anwendung muss ein interner DMZ-Server in der BPPROD bzw. sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_9a3902b310fecf504699cdb60f0cc9e9
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>false</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt_core.ChoiceSyncUtil</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ChoiceSyncUtil</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[
var ChoiceSyncUtil = Class.create();
ChoiceSyncUtil.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    // Target Choice field being fed by the options table
    TARGET_TABLE: 'sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item',
    TARGET_ELEMENT: 'u_lbbw_enviroment',

    /**
     * Insert or update the matching sys_choice record
     * based on a row from the LBBW enviroment options table.
     */
    syncChoice: function(sourceRecord) {
        var label = sourceRecord.getValue('u_label');

        var choiceGR = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        choiceGR.addQuery('name', this.TARGET_TABLE);
        choiceGR.addQuery('element', this.TARGET_ELEMENT);
        choiceGR.addQuery('value', label); // no separate value column, so label = value
        choiceGR.query();

        if (choiceGR.next()) {
            choiceGR.setValue('label', label);
            choiceGR.setValue('sequence', sourceRecord.getValue('u_sequence'));
            choiceGR.update();
        } else {
            choiceGR.initialize();
            choiceGR.setValue('name', this.TARGET_TABLE);
            choiceGR.setValue('element', this.TARGET_ELEMENT);
            choiceGR.setValue('value', label);
            choiceGR.setValue('label', label);
            choiceGR.setValue('sequence', sourceRecord.getValue('u_sequence'));
            choiceGR.setValue('language', 'en');
            choiceGR.insert();
        }
    },

    /**
     * Remove the matching sys_choice record when the source row is deleted.
     */
    removeChoice: function(sourceRecord) {
        var label = sourceRecord.getValue('u_label');

        var choiceGR = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
        choiceGR.addQuery('name', this.TARGET_TABLE);
        choiceGR.addQuery('element', this.TARGET_ELEMENT);
        choiceGR.addQuery('value', label);
        choiceGR.query();
        while (choiceGR.next()) {
            choiceGR.deleteRecord();
        }
    },

    type: 'ChoiceSyncUtil'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE64</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-26 07:58:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>9a3902b310fecf504699cdb60f0cc9e9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ChoiceSyncUtil</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_9a3902b310fecf504699cdb60f0cc9e9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE64</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-26 08:56:32</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188384daf0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_include_9a3902b310fecf504699cdb60f0cc9e9</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:33</sys_created_on><sys_id>56261568f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0844b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:33</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item">quoteISNOTEMPTY^EQ<item endquery="false" field="quote" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="ISNOTEMPTY" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Position Number</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /* null when async */) {
var parentQuote = current.getValue('quote');
// Defensive check: stop execution if no parent Quote is present
    if (!parentQuote) {
        return;
    }
// Query existing line items on the same Quote to find the highest assigned position number
    var grLineItem = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item');
    grLineItem.addQuery('quote', parentQuote);
    grLineItem.addNotNullQuery('u_position_number');
    grLineItem.orderByDesc('u_position_number');
    grLineItem.setLimit(1);
    grLineItem.query();
if (grLineItem.next()) {
        // Line items exist: next position = highest existing position + 1
        var highestPositionNumber = parseInt(grLineItem.getValue('u_position_number'), 10) || 0;
        current.setValue('u_position_number', highestPositionNumber + 1);
    } else {
        // First line item for this Quote
        current.setValue('u_position_number', 1);
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAD65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-08 11:20:11</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>aa651871c8b34310b96bb192bcbe7993</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Position Number</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_aa651871c8b34310b96bb192bcbe7993</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAD65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-08 11:20:11</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=aa651871c8b34310b96bb192bcbe7993"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883848ef0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_aa651871c8b34310b96bb192bcbe7993</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:32</sys_created_on><sys_id>c226d168f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc08490</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:32</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>
