sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Sync Customer status from State</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /* null when async */) {

    // On update, only run when the State has changed.
    // On insert, previous is null, so the mapping should always run.
    if (previous && !current.state.changes()) {
        return;
    }

    switch (current.getValue('state')) {

        case 'completed':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'Abgeschlossen');
            break;

        case 'in_review':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'Wird überprüft');
            break;

        case 'in_approval':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'In Bearbeitung');
            break;

        case 'expired':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'Abgelaufen');
            break;

        case 'rejected':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'Abgelehnt');
            break;

        case 'pending_customer_acceptance':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'Annahme durch Kunde steht aus');
            break;

        case 'canceled':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'Abgebrochen');
            break;

        case 'approved':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'In Bearbeitung');
            break;

        case 'closed':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'Geschlossen');
            break;

        case 'draft':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'Entwurf');
            break;

        case 'Waiting for information':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'In Bearbeitung');
            break;

        case 'waiting_info':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'Warten auf Kunde');
            break;

        case 'In Progress':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'In Bearbeitung');
            break;

        case 'revised':
            current.setValue('u_customer_status', 'Überarbeitet');
            break;
    }

})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAD65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-26 11:31:18</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>d47dfebf10f203904699cdb60f0cc9f7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Sync Customer status from State</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_d47dfebf10f203904699cdb60f0cc9f7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAD65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-28 07:05:41</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=d47dfebf10f203904699cdb60f0cc9f7"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188384cb80000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_d47dfebf10f203904699cdb60f0cc9f7</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:33</sys_created_on><sys_id>5e261568f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc08426</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:33</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt_core.QuoteRelatedPartyUtil</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Customers can override methods of QuoteRelatedPartyUtilOOB in this file</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>QuoteRelatedPartyUtil</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/*
var QuoteRelatedPartyUtil = Class.create();
QuoteRelatedPartyUtil.prototype = Object.extendsObject(QuoteRelatedPartyUtilOOB,{

    type: 'QuoteRelatedPartyUtil'
});
*/

/*
Changes related Digitall-SOM-STRY0025839
*/

var QuoteRelatedPartyUtil = Class.create();
QuoteRelatedPartyUtil.prototype = Object.extendsObject(QuoteRelatedPartyUtilOOB, {

	createRecordsForSellerOrganization: function(quoteGr, types) {
		var sellerOrganization = quoteGr.getValue('seller_organization');
		if (gs.nil(sellerOrganization)) {
			return;
		}
		if (!types) {
			types = [];
		}

		var configGR = new GlideRecordSecure(QuoteConstants.RELATED_PARTY_CONFIGURATION_TABLE);
		configGR.addQuery('entity_type', global.CSMBaseConstants.SERVICE_ORGANIZATION_TABLE);
		if (types.length > 0) {
			configGR.addQuery('name', 'IN', types);
		}
		configGR.addQuery('applies_to', 'sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote');
		configGR.query();
		while (configGR.next()) {
			var typeSysId = configGR.getValue('sys_id');
			if (this._activeRelatedPartyExists(quoteGr.getValue('sys_id'), typeSysId, '', sellerOrganization)) {
				continue;
			}

			var relatedPartyGR = new GlideRecordSecure(QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_ADDRESS_TABLE);
			relatedPartyGR.initialize();
			relatedPartyGR.setValue('quote', quoteGr.getValue('sys_id'));
			relatedPartyGR.setValue('type', typeSysId);
			relatedPartyGR.setValue('order', configGR.getValue('default_order'));
			relatedPartyGR.setValue('seller_organization', sellerOrganization);
			relatedPartyGR.setValue('responsibility', configGR.getValue('default_responsibility'));
			relatedPartyGR.insert();
		}
	},

	createRecordsForAccount: function(quoteGr, types) {
		var account = quoteGr.getValue('account');
		if (gs.nil(account)) {
			return;
		}
		if (!types) {
			types = [];
		}

		var primaryAccountAddress = this.getPrimaryAccountAddress(account);
		var configGR = new GlideRecordSecure(QuoteConstants.RELATED_PARTY_CONFIGURATION_TABLE);
		configGR.addQuery('entity_type', global.CSMBaseConstants.ACCOUNT_TABLE);
		if (types.length > 0) {
			configGR.addQuery('name', 'IN', types);
		}
		configGR.addQuery('applies_to', 'sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote');
		configGR.query();
		while (configGR.next()) {
			var typeSysId = configGR.getValue('sys_id');
			if (this._activeRelatedPartyExists(quoteGr.getValue('sys_id'), typeSysId, account, '')) {
				continue;
			}

			var relatedPartyGR = new GlideRecordSecure(QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_ADDRESS_TABLE);
			relatedPartyGR.initialize();
			relatedPartyGR.setValue('quote', quoteGr.getValue('sys_id'));
			relatedPartyGR.setValue('type', typeSysId);
			relatedPartyGR.setValue('order', configGR.getValue('default_order'));
			relatedPartyGR.setValue('account', account);
			if (!gs.nil(primaryAccountAddress)) {
				relatedPartyGR.setValue('account_address', primaryAccountAddress);
			}
			relatedPartyGR.setValue('responsibility', configGR.getValue('default_responsibility'));
			relatedPartyGR.insert();
		}
	},

	_activeRelatedPartyExists: function(quoteSysId, typeSysId, accountSysId, sellerOrganizationSysId) {
		var relatedPartyGR = new GlideRecord(QuoteConstants.QUOTE_RELATED_PARTY_TABLE);
		relatedPartyGR.addQuery('quote', quoteSysId);
		relatedPartyGR.addQuery('type', typeSysId);
		relatedPartyGR.addActiveQuery();
		if (GlidePluginManager.isActive('com.snc.business_organization_qm') && !gs.nil(sellerOrganizationSysId)) {
			relatedPartyGR.addQuery('seller_organization', sellerOrganizationSysId);
		} else {
			relatedPartyGR.addQuery('account', accountSysId);
		}
		relatedPartyGR.setLimit(1);
		relatedPartyGR.query();
		return relatedPartyGR.hasNext();
	},

	type: 'QuoteRelatedPartyUtil'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-12-28 16:58:12</sys_created_on><sys_id>3a310f92ffc232104acdffffffffff59</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>QuoteRelatedPartyUtil</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_3a310f92ffc232104acdffffffffff59</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-21 11:09:14</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883879280000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_include_3a310f92ffc232104acdffffffffff59</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>01369968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0845a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:44</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item">u_lbbw_pdvVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="u_lbbw_pdv" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>LBBW - Validate PdV format</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    var pdv = current.getValue('u_lbbw_pdv');

    if (!pdv) {
        return; // empty is fine, not every line item needs a PdV
    }

    var isValid = /^[0-9]{6}$/.test(pdv);

    if (!isValid) {
        gs.addErrorMessage('LBBW PdV must be exactly 6 numeric digits.');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
    }

})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE47</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-05 07:26:44</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>3ad38838c1bb8710b96bbab8b674a0da</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LBBW - Validate PdV format</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_3ad38838c1bb8710b96bbab8b674a0da</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE47</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-05 07:26:44</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=3ad38838c1bb8710b96bbab8b674a0da"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883857d70000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_3ad38838c1bb8710b96bbab8b674a0da</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>c3265568f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc084c8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:36</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote">quote_dateVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="quote_date" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Validate change of quote date</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    // 1. If not in Draft, this rule should not interfere (prevents blocking the Flow Designer)
    if (current.state != 'Draft') {
        return;
    }

    // 2. Safely check if date fields are being changed
    // We use .changes() only after ensuring the fields are not null/undefined
    var dateChanged = current.u_quote_date.changes() || current.u_expiration_date.changes();
   
    // 3. If dates are NOT changed, do nothing
    if (!dateChanged) {
        return;
    }

    // 4. Validate if there are quote lines (the original business logic requirement)
    var quoteLines = new sn_quote_mgmt_core.QuoteLineAPI().hasQuoteLines(current.sys_id);
   
    if (quoteLines) {
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        gs.addErrorMessage(QuoteMessage.QUOTE_DATE_CHANGE_VALIDATION);
    }

})(current, previous);

    if (isLoading || !newValue) {
        g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_email', '');
		g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_phone', '');
		g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_department', '');
        return;
    }

    g_form.getReference('u_contract_owner_name', function(contact) {
        if (contact) {
            g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_email', contact.email);
			g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_phone', contact.phone);
			g_form.setValue('u_contract_owner_department', contact.department);
        }
    });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-04 09:23:43</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>8b0a5fcbf528cb501f189cbe3ac712b3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Contract Owner fields</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_8b0a5fcbf528cb501f189cbe3ac712b3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-21 08:16:26</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188386caa0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>catalog_script_client_8b0a5fcbf528cb501f189cbe3ac712b3</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>dc361968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0849f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:41</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>true</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Quote - nur eigener Account (viewer)</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    if (!gs.hasRole('sn_quote_mgmt_core.quote_viewer')) {
        return;
    }

    var company = gs.getUser().getCompanyID();

    // Interne User dieser Company dürfen alle Quotes sehen -> nicht filtern
    if (company == '6ef7cfa1eb0343001f18be51f631df35') {
        return;
    }

    // Externe User: nur Quotes der eigenen Company
    if (company) {
        current.addQuery('account', company);
    }
    // kein company -> keine Einschränkung
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-19 13:34:59</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>8d969369103e0b504699cdb60f0cc917</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Quote - nur eigener Account (viewer)</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_8d969369103e0b504699cdb60f0cc917</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-19 13:54:45</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=8d969369103e0b504699cdb60f0cc917"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188385fc30000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_8d969369103e0b504699cdb60f0cc917</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:38</sys_created_on><sys_id>13269568f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc084d5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:38</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt_core.QuoteDateCalculator</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>QuoteDateCalculator</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var QuoteDateCalculator = Class.create();
QuoteDateCalculator.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        // Твоят специфичен sys_id на графика
        this.schedId = '869d962febc2f7041f18be51f631df12';
    },

    // Метод, който приема началната дата и броя дни
    calculateDueDate: function(startDateStr, daysToAdd) {
        var sched = new GlideSchedule(this.schedId);
        
        // Взимаме началната дата на създаване на записа
        var gdt = new GlideDateTime(startDateStr); 
        
        // Дефинираме продължителност за X работни дни (по 8 часа на ден)
        var duration = new GlideDuration(daysToAdd * 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        
        // Изчисляваме крайната дата спрямо работния график
        var result = sched.add(gdt, duration);
        
        // Връщаме датата във формат дд.мм.гггг
        return result.getLocalDate().getByFormat('dd.MM.yyyy');
    },

    type: 'QuoteDateCalculator'
};

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item</collection><condition/><description>LBBW - Auto-fill PDE for Eindeutig</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item">product_offeringVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="product_offering" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>LBBW - Auto-fill PDE for Eindeutig</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    if (!current.product_offering) {
        return;
    }

    var offering = new GlideRecord('sn_prd_pm_product_offering');
    if (!offering.get(current.getValue('product_offering'))) {
        gs.error('LBBW PDE auto-fill: Product Offering not found for QLI ' + current.getValue('number'));
        return;
    }

    if (offering.getValue('u_som_pde_category') != 'eindeutig') {
        return;
    }

    var pdeId = offering.getValue('u_som_pde_name');
    if (!pdeId) {
        gs.error('LBBW PDE auto-fill: category=eindeutig but u_som_pde_name empty on offering ' + offering.getValue('code'));
        return;
    }

    var pdeRecord = new GlideRecord('u_pde');
    pdeRecord.addQuery('u_id', pdeId);
    pdeRecord.query();
    if (pdeRecord.next()) {
        current.u_lbbw_pde = pdeRecord.getUniqueValue();
		current.u_lbbw_pde_pdv_id = pdeRecord.getValue('u_id');
		current.u_som_pde_name = pdeRecord.getValue('u_pde_name');
    } else {
        gs.error('LBBW PDE auto-fill: no u_pde record found with u_id=' + pdeId + ' (offering ' + offering.getValue('code') + ')');
    }

})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE47</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-01 14:00:27</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>768778e77c67cb101f180c59224b117c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LBBW - Auto-fill PDE for Eindeutig</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_768778e77c67cb101f180c59224b117c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE47</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-02 11:50:48</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=768778e77c67cb101f180c59224b117c"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883872fe0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_768778e77c67cb101f180c59224b117c</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>a4365968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0846d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:43</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sys_email</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sys_email">target_table=sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote^type=sent^EQ<item endquery="false" field="target_table" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value="sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote"/><item display_value="sent" endquery="false" field="type" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value="sent"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Link Sent Emails to Quote ACtivity</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    // Locate the parent Quote record
    var quote = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote');
    if (quote.get(current.instance)) {
        // Construct the log message
        var emailLog = "[Email Sent]\n";
        emailLog += "To: " + current.recipients + "\n";
        emailLog += "Subject: " + current.subject + "\n\n";
        emailLog += current.body_text; // Adds the plain text version of the email body

        // Force write into the Work Notes of the Quote, which updates the Activity Stream
        quote.work_notes = emailLog;
        quote.update();
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAD62</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-08 12:55:28</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>00aa5cea841d4750b96b6020db8226bd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Link Sent Emails to Quote ACtivity</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_00aa5cea841d4750b96b6020db8226bd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAD62</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-08 12:55:28</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=00aa5cea841d4750b96b6020db8226bd"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188384d240000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_00aa5cea841d4750b96b6020db8226bd</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:33</sys_created_on><sys_id>d6261568f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc08436</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:33</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_email"><sys_script_email action="DELETE"><name>fits_get_account_kam_recipients</name><new_lines_to_html>false</new_lines_to_html><script><![CDATA[(function runMailScript( /* GlideRecord */ current, /* TemplatePrinter */ template,
    /* Optional EmailOutbound */
    email, /* Optional GlideRecord */ email_action,
    /* Optional GlideRecord */
    event) {
		
    // 1. Get the Account Sys ID from the current Quote record
    var accountId = current.account;

    if (accountId) {
        // 2. Query the Account Team Members table for this specific account
        var teamGr = new GlideRecord('sn_customerservice_team_member');
        teamGr.addQuery('account', accountId);
        teamGr.query();

        while (teamGr.next()) {
            var userId = teamGr.user;
            var userEmail = teamGr.user.email;
            var userName = teamGr.user.name;

            if (userId && userEmail) {
                // 3. Verify if the team member possesses the active 'fits_itil_key_account_manager' role
                var roleCheckGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
                roleCheckGr.addQuery('user', userId);
                roleCheckGr.addQuery('role.name', 'fits_itil_key_account_manager');
                roleCheckGr.addQuery('state', 'active');
                roleCheckGr.query();

                if (roleCheckGr.hasNext()) {
                    // Add the valid KAM user as a recipient in the 'To' field
                    email.addAddress("to", userEmail, userName);
                }
            }
        }
    }
})(current, template, email, email_action, event);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_email</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAD62</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-11 12:12:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>965d27138d5dcb50b0e46017ca72a09f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>fits_get_account_kam_recipients</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_email_965d27138d5dcb50b0e46017ca72a09f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAD62</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-11 12:14:44</sys_updated_on></sys_script_email></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_c5f399859dc49f10469964740436fb54
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt_core.QLIClientUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>QLIClientUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var QLIClientUtils = Class.create();
QLIClientUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    checkRepriseBtnVisibility: function(current) {

        // check if the sn_quote_mgmt_core_pricing_adjustment has already record for this QLI type Price override
        var priceAdj = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_pricing_adjustment');
        priceAdj.addQuery('quote_line_item', current.sys_id);
        //priceAdj.addQuery('applicable_to', 'UNIT_QTY');
        priceAdj.addQuery('adjustment_source', 'MANUAL');
        //priceAdj.addQuery('adjustment_type', 'e94d634b0c21bd10f877f663a8e70c39'); // Price override
        priceAdj.query();

        if (priceAdj.next()) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    },

    processPriceAdjustmentCreation: function() {

        var table = this.getParameter('sysparm_table');
        var quoteId = this.getParameter('sysparm_quote_id');
        var lineId = this.getParameter('sysparm_quote_line_id');
        var adjustmentValue = this.getParameter('sysparm_amount');

        // check if record exists if it does update it
        var shouldCreateOrUpdate = this.createOrUpdatePriceAdjustment(table, lineId, adjustmentValue);

        if (table && adjustmentValue && shouldCreateOrUpdate) {

            var priceAdj = new GlideRecord(table);
            priceAdj.initialize();
            priceAdj.setValue('quote', quoteId);
            priceAdj.setValue('quote_line_item', lineId);
            priceAdj.setValue('applicable_to', 'UNIT_QTY');
            priceAdj.setValue('adjustment_source', 'MANUAL');
            priceAdj.setValue('adjustment_type', 'e94d634b0c21bd10f877f663a8e70c39'); // Price override
            priceAdj.setValue('adjustment_value', adjustmentValue);

            var priceAdjRecord = priceAdj.insert();

            if (priceAdjRecord) {
                return 'success_created';
            }

            return 'failed';
        } else if (!shouldCreateOrUpdate) {
            return 'success_updated';
        }
    },

    createOrUpdatePriceAdjustment: function(table, lineId, adjustmentValue) {

        var priceAdj = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_pricing_adjustment');
        priceAdj.addQuery('quote_line_item', lineId);
        priceAdj.addQuery('adjustment_source', 'MANUAL');
        priceAdj.query();

        if (priceAdj.next()) {
            priceAdj.setValue('adjustment_value', adjustmentValue);
            priceAdj.update();
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    },

    type: 'QLIClientUtils'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEZG57</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-18 18:06:12</sys_created_on><sys_id>c5f399859dc49f10469964740436fb54</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>QLIClientUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_c5f399859dc49f10469964740436fb54</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEZG57</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-20 21:18:53</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a188386fb60000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_include_c5f399859dc49f10469964740436fb54</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>50365968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc08401</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:42</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote">stateCHANGESTOin_review^ORstateCHANGESTOpending_customer_acceptance^ORstateCHANGESTOwaiting_info^ORstateCHANGESTOcanceled^EQ<item display_value="In review" endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="CHANGESTO" or="false" value="in_review"/><item display_value="Pending customer acceptance" endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="CHANGESTO" or="true" value="pending_customer_acceptance"/><item display_value="Waiting for information (customer)" endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="CHANGESTO" or="true" value="waiting_info"/><item display_value="Canceled" endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="CHANGESTO" or="true" value="canceled"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Quote Synchro state to Quote Task</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    // Quote Task finden (nur SLA-Task)
    var quoteTaskGR = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_task');
    quoteTaskGR.addQuery('quote', current.sys_id);
    quoteTaskGR.addQuery('short_description', 'SLA Angebotszeit');
    quoteTaskGR.query();

    if (!quoteTaskGR.next()) {
        //gs.info('Kein SLA-Task gefunden für Quote ' + current.number);
        return;
    }

    
    var newState = null;

    // Wenn Quote → in_review
    if (current.state.toString() == 'in_review') {
        newState = '2';  
    }
    // Wenn Quote → pending_customer_acceptance
    else if (current.state.toString() == 'pending_customer_acceptance') {
        newState = '3'; 
		// Work Notes eintragen (Angebot wurde abgeben)
        quoteTaskGR.work_notes = 'Angebot wurde an Kunde übermittelt.';
    }

	// Wenn Quote → canceled
    else if (current.state.toString() == 'canceled') {
        newState = '4'; 
		// Work Notes eintragen (Angebot wurde abgebrochen)
        quoteTaskGR.work_notes = 'Angebotsprozess wurde abgebrochen.';
    }

	// Wenn Quote → waiting_info
    else if (current.state.toString() == 'waiting_info') {
        newState = '8'; 
    }

    // State setzen, wenn Quote Task gefunden
    if (newState && quoteTaskGR.state.toString() != newState) {
        quoteTaskGR.state = newState;
        quoteTaskGR.update();
        //gs.info('Quote Task State aktualisiert auf ' + newState + ' für Quote ' + current.number);
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-02 11:23:05</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>becaef4619b98b10b96b094a971f7732</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Quote Synchro state to Quote Task</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_becaef4619b98b10b96b094a971f7732</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-09 22:14:18</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=becaef4619b98b10b96b094a971f7732"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883877f10000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_becaef4619b98b10b96b094a971f7732</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>09369968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0842d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:44</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_email"><sys_script_email action="DELETE"><name>calculate_quote_due_date</name><new_lines_to_html>false</new_lines_to_html><script><![CDATA[(function runMailScript(current, template, email, email_action, event) {
    var calc = new QuoteDateCalculator();
    var targetDate = '';
    
    var templateName = email_action.name; 

    if (templateName.indexOf('Einfach') > -1) {
        targetDate = calc.calculateDueDate(current.sys_created_on, 10);
    } else if (templateName.indexOf('Mittel') > -1) {
        targetDate = calc.calculateDueDate(current.sys_created_on, 20);
    } else {
        targetDate = current.due_date ? new GlideDateTime(current.due_date).getLocalDate().getByFormat('dd.MM.yyyy') : "manuell zu vereinbaren";
    }

    template.print(targetDate);
})(current, template, email, email_action, event);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_email</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAD62</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-25 11:13:21</sys_created_on><sys_id>24f623f3e8e5c3101f181b0e561ff8c2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>calculate_quote_due_date</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_email_24f623f3e8e5c3101f181b0e561ff8c2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAD62</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-25 11:27:11</sys_updated_on></sys_script_email></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt_core.SOMQuoteGroupChecker</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>Checks if a certain User has a KAM Group</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>SOMQuoteGroupChecker</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var QuoteGroupChecker = Class.create();
 
QuoteGroupChecker.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
 
    isLoggedInUserInGroup: function() {
 
        var memberGR = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
        memberGR.addQuery('user', gs.getUserID());
		// FtRg_Srv_AppServiceNowSOMVertriebKAM_Mod

        memberGR.addQuery(
            'group',
            'c584b821d5b58fd01f183ff0f14f77aa'
        );
        memberGR.setLimit(1);
        memberGR.query();
 
        return memberGR.hasNext();
    },
 
    type: 'QuoteGroupChecker'
});
 




]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC70</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 09:11:27</sys_created_on><sys_id>988685fd9c0b4790b0e4a23b78988317</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SOMQuoteGroupChecker</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_988685fd9c0b4790b0e4a23b78988317</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC70</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 10:05:52</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883876d70000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_include_988685fd9c0b4790b0e4a23b78988317</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>bc369968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc08403</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:44</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="IT-Anforderungscheckliste - FI-TS">e918ec0984c50710b96b6020db8226b2</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:b718e04984c50710b96b6020db822618</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>SubmitDateValidation</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue === '') {
        return;
    }

    // Get the current date without time
    var currentDate = new Date();
	currentDate.setHours(0,0,0,0);

    // Get the value of ita_desired_submission_date
    var newDate = newValue.split('.');
    var submissionDate = new Date(newDate[2] + '-' +newDate[1] + '-' + newDate[0]);
    // Check if submissionDate is in the past
    if (submissionDate < currentDate) {
        g_form.clearValue('u_quote_due_date');
        g_form.showFieldMsg('u_quote_due_date', 'Der Termin liegt in der Vergangenheit.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    // Get the value of ita_desired_deployment_date
    var deploymentDate = g_form.getValue('u_latest_delivery_date');
    if (deploymentDate) {
		deploymentDate = deploymentDate.split(".");
		deploymentDateParsed = new Date(deploymentDate[2] + '-' +deploymentDate[1] + '-' + deploymentDate[0]);

        // Compare submissionDate and deploymentDate
        if (submissionDate > deploymentDateParsed) {
            g_form.clearValue('u_quote_due_date');
            g_form.showFieldMsg('u_quote_due_date', 'Der Bereitstellungstermin darf nicht vor dem Termin für die Vorlage des Angebots liegen.', 'error');
        }
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-22 11:44:43</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>4638ac4984c50710b96b6020db8226bb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SubmitDateValidation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_4638ac4984c50710b96b6020db8226bb</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-22 11:44:43</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a18838594e0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>catalog_script_client_4638ac4984c50710b96b6020db8226bb</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>0b265568f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc084f8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:36</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="IT-Anforderungscheckliste - BayernLB">e64c1801d4ec0750b0e430d0df3c400b</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:d34c9801d4ec0750b0e430d0df3c4083</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Latest Delivery Date Validation</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    // Get the current date without time
    var currentDate = new Date();
    currentDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    // Get the value of ita_desired_deployment_date
    var newDate = newValue.split('.');
    var deploymentDate = new Date(newDate[2] + '-' + newDate[1] + '-' + newDate[0]);
    // Check if deploymentDate is in the past
    if (deploymentDate < currentDate) {
        g_form.clearValue('u_latest_delivery_date');
        g_form.showFieldMsg('u_latest_delivery_date', 'Der Termin liegt in der Vergangenheit.', 'error');
        return;
    }

    // Get the value of ita_desired_submission_date
    var submissionDate = g_form.getValue('u_quote_due_date');
    if (submissionDate) {
        submissionDate = submissionDate.split(".");
        submissionDateParsed = new Date(submissionDate[2] + '-' + submissionDate[1] + '-' + submissionDate[0]);

        // Compare submissionDate and deploymentDate
        if (deploymentDate < submissionDateParsed) {
            g_form.clearValue('u_latest_delivery_date');
            g_form.showFieldMsg('u_latest_delivery_date', 'Der Bereitstellungstermin darf nicht vor dem Termin für die Vorlage des Angebots liegen.', 'error');
        }
    }

}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-27 14:21:29</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>ea5cdc01d4ec0750b0e430d0df3c4096</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Latest Delivery Date Validation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_ea5cdc01d4ec0750b0e430d0df3c4096</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-12 13:29:54</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a18838523d0000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>catalog_script_client_ea5cdc01d4ec0750b0e430d0df3c4096</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>e6261568f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc084f5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:34</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

13:52:05</sys_updated_on><value>(function execute(inputs, outputs) {
    var approvers = [];
    var team = inputs.team_members;
    var roles = inputs.kam_roles;
   
    // Събираме всички ID-та от екипа в един масив
    var teamIds = [];
    while(team.next()) {
        teamIds.push(team.user.toString());
    }

    // Сравняваме: ако човекът с роля е в списъка на екипа, добавяме го
    while(roles.next()) {
        if(teamIds.indexOf(roles.user.toString()) > -1) {
            approvers.push(roles.user.toString());
        }
    }
   
    // Връщаме готовия списък с потребители
    outputs.approvers_list = approvers;
})(inputs, outputs);

Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
Finanz Informatik Technologie Service

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt_core.QuoteAcceptanceUtil</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>Set all QLI acceptance group values of a Quote to "1". Called by UI Action "Gesamtabnahme"</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>QuoteAcceptanceUtil</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var QuoteAcceptanceUtil = Class.create();
QuoteAcceptanceUtil.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    
    setOverallAcceptance: function() {
        var quoteSysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_quote_sys_id');
        if (gs.nil(quoteSysId)) return false;
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_line_item');
        gr.addQuery('quote', quoteSysId);
        gr.query();
        var updated = 0;
        while (gr.next()) {
            gr.u_som_acceptance_group = '1';
            gr.update();
            updated++;
        }
        return true;
    },
    
    type: 'QuoteAcceptanceUtil'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-11 13:50:33</sys_created_on><sys_id>c54dc2831022cf104699cdb60f0cc925</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>QuoteAcceptanceUtil</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_c54dc2831022cf104699cdb60f0cc925</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-11 14:42:32</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883880510000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_include_c54dc2831022cf104699cdb60f0cc925</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>ed36d968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc08453</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:46</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_54085f1f7c2f8b101f180c59224b119e
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_quote_mgmt_core.PDEReferenceQualifier</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>PDEReferenceQualifier</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var PDEReferenceQualifier = Class.create();
PDEReferenceQualifier.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    getQualifier: function(current) {
        var offeringId = current.getValue('product_offering');
        if (!offeringId) {
            return '';
        }
        var off = new GlideRecord('sn_prd_pm_product_offering');
        if (!off.get(offeringId)) {
            gs.error('PDEReferenceQualifier: Product Offering not found for QLI ' + current.getValue('number'));
            return '';
        }
        var category = off.getValue('u_som_pde_category');
        var ids = [];
        if (category == 'eindeutig') {
            var singleId = off.getValue('u_som_pde_name');
            if (singleId) {
                ids.push(singleId);
            } else {
                gs.warn('PDEReferenceQualifier: category=eindeutig but u_som_pde_name empty on offering ' + off.getValue('code'));
            }
        } else if (category == 'Individual' || category == 'Auswahl') {
            ['u_lbbw_product_er1', 'u_lbbw_product_er2', 'u_lbbw_product_er3', 'u_lbbw_product_er4'].forEach(function(f) {
                if (!off.getValue(f)) {
                    return;
                }
                var ref = off.getElement(f).getRefRecord();
                if (ref && ref.isValidRecord() && ref.getValue('u_id')) {
                    ids.push(ref.getValue('u_id'));
                } else {
                    gs.warn('PDEReferenceQualifier: ' + f + ' on offering ' + off.getValue('code') +
                        ' references a u_pde record that is missing or has no u_id - excluded from selection');
                }
            });
            if (ids.length === 0) {
                gs.info('PDEReferenceQualifier: category=' + category + ' with no stored PDE IDs on offering ' +
                    off.getValue('code') + ' - offering full catalog per AC');
            }
        }

        ids = ids.filter(function(v, i) {
            return ids.indexOf(v) === i;
        });
        return ids.length ? 'u_idIN' + ids.join(',') : '';
    },

    type: 'PDEReferenceQualifier'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAE47</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-01 06:59:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>54085f1f7c2f8b101f180c59224b119e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PDEReferenceQualifier</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_54085f1f7c2f8b101f180c59224b119e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAE47</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-06 11:37:37</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883849560000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_include_54085f1f7c2f8b101f180c59224b119e</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:32</sys_created_on><sys_id>0a26d168f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc0849e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:32</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>true</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_associated_contact</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Update Quote Associated Contacts Emails</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    var quoteSysId = current.quote.toString();
    if (!quoteSysId) return;

    var emails = [];

    // 1. Query associated contacts ONLY for Technical and Commercial roles via Reference name
    var gr = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_associated_contact');
    gr.addQuery('quote', quoteSysId);
    gr.addQuery('type.name', 'IN', ['Technischer Ansprechpartner', 'Kaufmännischer Ansprechpartner']);
    gr.query();

    while (gr.next()) {
        if (gr.contact) {
            var contactGR = gr.contact.getRefRecord();
            if (contactGR && contactGR.isValidRecord() && !contactGR.email.nil()) {
                emails.push(contactGR.getValue('email').trim());
            }
        }
    }

    // 2. Deduplicate emails array using native JavaScript
    var uniqueEmails = emails.filter(function(item, pos) {
        return emails.indexOf(item) == pos;
    });

    // 3. Update the technical field on the Quote record
    var quoteGR = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote');
    if (quoteGR.get(quoteSysId)) {
        quoteGR.setValue('u_associated_contacts_emails', uniqueEmails.join(', '));
        quoteGR.setWorkflow(false); // Prevent infinite loops
        quoteGR.update();
    }

})(current, previous);

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote</collection><condition/><description>Quote Synchro complexity to Quote Task</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote">u_complexityVALCHANGES^EQ<item display_value="-- None --" endquery="false" field="u_complexity" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Quote Synchro complexity to Quote Task</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    // Quote Task finden, der:
    // 1. zu dieser Quote gehört 
    // 2. short_description = "SLA Angebotszeit" (nur diese Tasks werden aktualisiert)
    
    var quoteTaskGR = new GlideRecord('sn_quote_mgmt_core_quote_task');
    quoteTaskGR.addQuery('quote', current.sys_id);
    quoteTaskGR.addQuery('short_description', 'SLA Angebotszeit');  // Exakter Match
    quoteTaskGR.query();

    while (quoteTaskGR.next()) {
        // Nur updaten, wenn sich der Wert wirklich geändert hat
        if (quoteTaskGR.u_complexity != current.u_complexity) {
            quoteTaskGR.u_complexity = current.u_complexity;
            quoteTaskGR.update();
        }
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>IZEAC71</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-02 08:51:17</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>16e60b0219398b10b96b094a971f778e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Quote Synchro complexity to Quote Task</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Data Model" source="sn_quote_mgmt_core">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_16e60b0219398b10b96b094a971f778e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>IZEAC71</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-02 08:58:09</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=16e60b0219398b10b96b094a971f778e"/><sys_claim action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><claim_owner_scope display_value="Quote Management Data Model">d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</claim_owner_scope><claim_timestamp>1a1883882250000001</claim_timestamp><metadata_update_name>sys_script_16e60b0219398b10b96b094a971f778e</metadata_update_name><previous_claim_app_version>11.2.3</previous_claim_app_version><previous_claim_name>Quote Management Data Model</previous_claim_name><previous_claim_scope>d5457076b70131101aaebe508e11a907</previous_claim_scope><sys_created_by>IZEAE65</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:12:47</sys_created_on><sys_id>6136d968f0d0db10b0e43cf86fc08490</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>IZEAE65</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 15:12:47</sys_updated_on></sys_claim></record_update>
